nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; used as the sole access-control gate for delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; infinite allowance to UNI router is pre-set for the owner in the constructor.
Private sale counter compared against _onSaleNum[_from] inside condition().
Private trade address whitelisted by ensure(); writable only through setTradeAddress by owner.
Public total supply fixed in the constructor as _supply*(10**decimals).
Private minimum sale amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Private maximum sale amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Private mapping(address=>bool) of addresses bypassing the sale condition checks in ensure().
Private mapping counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Public payable transfer that delegates straight into transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable core transfer routine: mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Internal view whitelist gate; recomputes the Uniswap pair for this token and falls back to condition(_from,_value).
Internal view sale rule checker for _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale and per-address _onSaleNum.
Public payable owner-only function performing a raw delegatecall to an arbitrary address a with calldata b.
Public payable owner-only mass distribution; computes total = _value * _tos.length and loops over _tos.
Public owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum but declares a bool return value it never returns.
Public owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Public payable approve() that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
msg.sender: caller identity used for owner checks, allowance spending and balance debits.
Raw low-level delegatecall a.delegatecall(b) to an attacker-chosen address, executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom after only a >= check; no SafeMath.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend that can wrap and under-report the debited amount.
init() declared returns(bool) but has no return statement, so callers receive garbage/false.
Parameter _from of transferFrom: the debited account and the subject of the whitelist checks.
Parameter _to of transferFrom: the credited recipient.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: transfer amount validated against condition/_minSale/_maxSale.
Local _UNI in ensure(): the Uniswap V2 pair address derived from pairFor for this token.
Parameter _tos of batchSend: array of recipient addresses iterated in the distribution loop.
Local total in batchSend: _value * _tos.length debited from the caller.
Parameter saleNum of init: assigned to the _saleNum state variable.
Parameter a of delegate: arbitrary target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate: arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to _from and, when different, spends allowance[_from][msg.sender] and mutates balances in transferFrom.
require(msg.sender == owner) guards the arbitrary delegatecall entry point in delegate().
require(msg.sender == owner) gates batchSend's mass balance redistribution.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates init(), which rewrites sale parameters.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates setTradeAddress, letting the owner whitelist an arbitrary trade address.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity supplied by the user.
transfer() forwards execution directly to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to pass before any balance mutation, chaining into the whitelist logic.
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted accounts.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value before the balance check.
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] -= _value and credits balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend increments balanceOf[_to] inside a loop over attacker-supplied recipients.
init() writes _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale but never returns the declared bool.
delegate() performs a raw a.delegatecall(b) callback into an arbitrary contract with full storage control.
_from is the address tested against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale inside ensure().
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
local _UNI is computed via pairFor() and compared to _from in the ensure() whitelist.
the _tos array length multiplies into the unchecked total used to debit the caller.
parameter a is the arbitrary target of the delegatecall performed in delegate().
parameter b is the user-supplied calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
init() assigns parameter saleNum into the _saleNum state variable.
local total in batchSend is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].

normalization_plan.reason: _from only flows into the ensure() whitelist check, so fold the parameter into that core function.
_to is a plain recipient parameter consumed directly by transferFrom balance updates.
_value only feeds the condition() sale-limit comparisons.
local _UNI exists solely for the ensure() whitelist comparison.
_tos is an argument of batchSend and has no life outside the distribution loop.
local total is an intermediate value of the batchSend debit computation.
saleNum parameter is immediately written into _saleNum by init().
parameter a is only the delegatecall target inside delegate().
parameter b is only the delegatecall payload inside delegate().
